mapper.select: SELECT id, name, url, avatar, description, group_name AS `group`, email, status, sort, DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime, DATE_FORMAT(update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updateTime FROM t_friend WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = #{param.status} ORDER BY sort ASC, create_time DESC, id DESC
